replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Spoofed planner message on unauthenticated queue triggers unauthorized charge; supported by evidence."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Repeats same lack-of-authorization/privilege misuse harm as T1 (payments agent trusting any queue sender).","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack vector: prompt injection via flight data manipulating planner, not direct queue spoofing."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct harm: lack of traceability/forensics, not unauthorized charge itself."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct harm: confidentiality/PII exposure via queue reading, not charge manipulation."},{"id":"T6","keep":false,"reason":"Tampering to alter charge amount duplicates T1's core harm of unauthorized/altered charge via unauthenticated queue.","duplicateOf":"T1"}]}
